title: Art J NDE 5290
content: When I was around 8 years old, my parents were not home, and my brother was mad, doing something in the middle of the floor, next to the front door. I ended up doing something that pissed him off. He chased me around, and so I hid next to my mom's bed. Now I know to move around to different places when I'm trying to hide, but I didn't know that then. He found me, pinned me down on the bed and, with rage in his eyes, started choking me. I cried out to him, 'Stop!' and then, 'I can't breathe!' He didn't listen. Instead, his grip got stronger. I heard something like a snap, and then I was out cold. I remember drifting up from my body and seeing him back away and put his hands on his head. He stayed in that position for a while. The next thing I remember is looking at myself and seeing a bluish aura. I looked, I think, straight ahead and saw what looked like a rough cave. It was too dark to see to the end. Around me was darkness. Although at that point I couldn't move, I could see the sides of the cave. It was pitch black but I could see a cloaked figure with its hood down to its chest. It lifted its, I think, hand, draped in the cloak's sleeve and pointed at me what looked like an abnormally long finger made of, I think, bone, and said, 'You.' The last thing I remember was being in a dark place with him beside me. Also there were some smoke-like things. I think the next day I got up and my brother told me that I hadn't had a heartbeat for 4 to 5 hours. After the death I felt like I was being followed by the thing, and every once in a while I would actually see him. Nowadays I don't know if he's still following me and I've just grown accustomed to him being there, or if he has stopped. After this experience, most things changed. There is something weird that happens now. If I concentrate hard enough, I'm pretty sure I can see the dead. I'm only saying 'the dead' because most times no one else sees what I see and I don't think they are ordinary things. I don't really know what it is I'm seeing.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A dark, rough cave-like space: 'what looked like a rough cave. It was too dark to see to the end.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A cloaked figure in the darkness pointed a long bone-like finger and said, 'You.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Choked by brother as a child.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Cloaked figure in darkness; bluish aura around body; smoke-like things; sense of being followed afterward.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (rose above body, saw brother) followed by darkness/rough cave-like space and encounter with a cloaked figure.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Cloaked figure in a pitch-black cave-like space pointed a long bone-like finger and said, 'You.' Experiencer reports feeling followed afterward and intermittently seeing the figure.
